Subset a run_diff_summary table while keeping its footnote attributes

Source: R/run_diff.R
sub-.run_diff_summary.Rd

Base `[.data.frame` keeps class on subsetting but drops other attributes, so a plain tbl[rows, ] (e.g. filtering to significant rows) silently loses the df_footnote / pvalue_legend attributes that as_gt.run_diff_summary relies on even though class(tbl) still reads "run_diff_summary". This method re-attaches them after subsetting. It does not help across rbind() / dplyr verbs / as.data.frame(), which bypass this method entirely; recombine run_diff_summary tables after calling as_gt on each (or re-attach the attributes manually) if you need the footnotes to survive a merge.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'run_diff_summary'
x[...]

Arguments

x

A run_diff_summary data frame.

...

Forwarded to `[.data.frame`.

Value

The subset, re-classed as run_diff_summary when the result is still a data frame.
